items.title: A blowing up whose fibres have dimension at most d - 1 bounds the cohomological dimension of the ideal by d
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement bounds the cohomological dimension of an ideal by d whenever the blowing up of the ideal has fibres of dimension at most d - 1 (author lemma at source lines 870-876, label lemma-cd-blowup). The proof (source lines 878-900) is an application of the Leray spectral sequence: the inclusion of the complement of the zero locus into the blowing up is affine because the exceptional divisor is an effective Cartier divisor, the higher direct images of the blowing up itself vanish above the fibre dimension, and the two vanishing statements combine to the vanishing of the cohomology of the complement from degree d on (proof lines 891-899). The composition of the two vanishing statements through Leray is the content. H2.
